proof_summary: The sum satisfies the recurrence \(a_{n+1}=2^{\binom{n+1}{2}}+(2^n-1)a_n\); for odd prime \(p\), Fermat’s theorem makes both coefficients repeat after \(2(p-1)\), while at the initial shifted step \(2^{2(p-1)}-1\equiv0\) and the remaining power is \(1\), so induction propagates the congruence. For \(p=2\), the same recurrence shows every \(a_n\) with \(n\ge1\) is odd.
